concepts.name: Mole-inspired Clean landing
concepts.prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup. Generate a single straight-on native macOS app screenshot, landscape, entire window visible, with a narrow neutral desktop margin.
References: image 1 is the real Mole official Clean screenshot. Image 2 is the real Mole official Apps file-review screenshot. Image 3 is the exact Tebo logo to retain. Use the first two for structure, typography, proportions and restraint. This must be a Tebo concept, with no Mole logo or name.
Match the real app's plain matte dark ink-blue canvas, approximately #22263B. Only a barely perceptible vertical tonal change. Small native red/yellow/green traffic lights at top left, simple 14pt window corners, restrained thin native controls. Text is neutral white with quiet gray-blue supporting text. Compact monospaced tab labels, readable native system body typography. The active tab and main action are plain white filled capsules with black text. No electric blue, neon, glossy plastic, translucent glass effects, shadows around every item or decorative gradient wallpaper.
Borrow Mole's actual compact centered top capsule navigation, with a 24px Tebo logo at its start, and six exact labels: "Clean", "Uninstall", "Optimize", "Analyze", "Status", "Project Cleanup". Select "Clean" with a white pill. Keep a compact separate workspace selector toward the upper left beneath the traffic lights, labels exactly "File cleanup" and "image cleanup". Do not invent more controls or features. A small settings gear in upper right; "History" as a quiet footer utility.
Important change from the previous Tebo concepts: NO left navigation sidebar, NO right logo inspector, NO three-column dashboard, NO oversized headline or category cards. There is one coherent content pane, like the official Mole app. Logo must remain the supplied black rounded square with white ribbon T and two sparkles. Keep original proportions and artwork.
Use only the exact requested labels below. No fictional scan sizes, scan dates, file paths, personal data, additional marketing slogans or unsupported features. No screenshot title outside the app, no watermark, no device mockup or perspective. High-fidelity realistic app UI, not a promotional render.
Screen composition: closely follow the quiet centered Clean landing in reference 1. Place the supplied Tebo app mark at medium size, about 140px on a 1350px wide app window, centered slightly above mid-height. A simple, hairline neutral scan circle can surround it with generous padding; absolutely no luminous halo, orbiting particles, extra objects or planetary illustration. Preserve the source's large uninterrupted negative space.
Directly below the mark, bold rounded system text "Ready to scan" on one line. A smaller muted line "Review caches, app leftovers and installers." Below that, a plain white capsule about 200px wide and 42px high labeled "Scan Mac". At lower left a small eye icon with "Preview is on", lower right "History". This is the pre-scan state. Do not copy the sample found-space or item counts from Mole's screenshot. Keep the top tab navigation visually modest. Do not fill the blank area with stats, cards or promotional text.

Use only the exact requested labels below. No fictional scan sizes, scan dates, file paths, personal data, additional marketing slogans or unsupported features. No screenshot title outside the app, no watermark, no device mockup or perspective. High-fidelity realistic app UI, not a promotional render.
Screen composition: practical full-width category review, borrowing the low-chrome rows and footer arrangement from reference 2, while using the same quiet ink-blue theme as the Tebo landing and reference 1.
Below the top capsule, at upper left a modest heading "Clean", a muted subtitle "Choose what to review", and an understated text note "Nothing scanned yet". Upper right a small search field "Search categories…" beside a white capsule "Scan Mac".
The main pane is one clean full-width list with column headings "Category", "Includes", "Status". No enclosing card and no coloured circular icon backgrounds. Use slim understated line icons, a small unchecked checkbox per row, hairline separators and six consistent 58px rows. Rows, verbatim:
"Caches" / "Rebuildable app cache files" / "Not scanned"
"Logs" / "Old application logs" / "Not scanned"
"App leftovers" / "Data from uninstalled apps" / "Not scanned"
"Developer caches" / "Build and package caches" / "Not scanned"
"Downloaded installers" / "DMG, PKG and installer ZIP files" / "Not scanned"
"Temporary files" / "Unused temporary data" / "Not scanned"
Small text labels are readable, carefully aligned, with ample horizontal breathing room. Do not add measured numbers or fabricated files. Leave remaining space plain.
A thin horizontal footer at bottom has an eye icon and "Preview is on" at left, "History" nearby, and a visibly disabled neutral low-emphasis capsule "Move to Trash" at the lower right. This is a functional pre-scan screen, not a dashboard. All row heights are identical, all content is visible, no scrollbar.
